**1.1 first item = #210 (fix release-gate ordering)**

UPDATE (2026-07-25): #210 (fix the release-gate ordering) is now the FIRST item of the 1.1 line, promoted to the top out of M6. Reason: at the 1.0 cut, release.yml ran on the v1.0.0 tag and returned failure because it runs AFTER the tag already exists so it cannot block — proved the release-integrity gap live.
Revised 1.1 order: #210 -> M2 -> M3 -> M4 -> M5 -> M8 -> M6(rest) -> M7. M0 housekeeping in parallel.
#210 is OPEN without status:approved -> needs maintainer signature before its fix PR. The MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md / brain-v2-epic-plan.md reorder folds into that first 1.1 PR (avoid a doc-only PR to protected main).
Recorded in: epic #313 (comment), local design-docs/brain-v2-epic-plan.md.
AUDIT FULLY IN REPO on main (verified): docs/inbox/{MASTER-PLAN-1.0,brain-v2-epic-plan,brain-v2-merge-audit,reviewer-mechanisms-comparison}.md, docs/KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md, brain/project/decisions/adr-0024-three-axis-decoupling.md. 1.1 can start from the repo alone.
Related: [[architecture/release-strategy-1.0]] [[architecture/v2-epic-plan]].
